details.description: The Carpet Stain Remover from Dr. Beckmann is specially designed to combat a whole range of typical carpet stains, while being gentle on fibres. The powerful cleaning formula with its oxy-power formula can be optimally applied with the brush applicator. It can even eliminate stubborn red wine stains or coffee stains on carpets in 3 minutes without leaving any residue. Additionally, special ingredients are able to permanently eliminate the odours caused by the stain and leave a pleasant fresh scent. The formula is gentle to colours and fibres and also suitable for wool.
details.ingredients: Less than 5% Anionic Surfactants, Non-Ionic Surfactants, Oxygen-Based Bleaching Agents, Benzisothiazolinone, Methylisothiazolinone, Perfumes
details.usageInstructions:
1. Unscrew the brush head, pierce the seal in the size of a pinhead (about 2 mm) and screw the brush head on again (do not screw it too far).
2. Remove loose surface dirt. Hold the bottle head down and squeeze lightly to wet the applicator sponge. Apply the product (do not soak the carpet completely), work it lightly into the fabric and let it work in for 3 minutes.
3. Dab off the product and residual stain completely with a damp, light-coloured cloth. Repeat if necessary. Rinse the applicator after every use.
Important Information:
Before use: test for colour fastness and material compatibility on an inconspicuous area.
Always follow care label instructions for carpet.
Not suitable for silk, velvet and fabrics sensitive to water.
Store the bottle in an upright position. Floors in households with small children or pets often find themselves under heavy strain
From dirty shoes, spilt drinks and bits of food to all kinds of grime from dogs and cats.

details.description: The Dr. Beckmann Advanced solution with the innovative colour collecting molecules technology offers effective and efficient colour protection for your laundry. The proven microfibre structure locks colour securely in. At the same time, colour collecting molecules, released from the sheet, bind efficiently more colour in the water. As a result, your laundry stays fresh and vibrant looking.
details.usageInstructions:
Fill your washing machine with your laundry and add detergent as recommended.
Place 1-2 sheets in your washing machine, depending on the colour intensity of your textiles. Start the desired washing cycle.
Simply remove the sheet at the end of the wash and throw it away from the normal waste.

details.description:
The Stain Devils Fat & Sauces is based on multi-fat remover formula, which is a combination of various highly effective surfactants. They saturate the stain and dissolve it from the fabric.
Ideal for: stains of barbecue sauce, butter chocolate, cooking fat, dips, fatty sauces, roast sauce, ketchup, margarine, mayonnaise, mustard, pasta sauce, pesto, salad, dressing, salad oil, spices, sauces, vegetable oil, chocolate, hazelnut spread, blood.
Not suitable for: Leather, suede, acetate/rayon, carpets or upholstery.
details.usageInstructions:
Soak the stain with Stain Devil liquid, leave it to work and then wash. In the case of non-washable fabrics, dab up the stained area thoroughly with a damp cloth.
For details see the description. Before using the test for colourfastness: Apply a small amount of solution on an inconspicuous area and leave until dry.
If there is no change in colour, continue following the instructions above.
Always rinse the tested area with warm water and follow the garment’s wash care label.

details.description: Where food is stored or prepared, hygienic cleanliness is essential. Regular cleaning of refrigerators, microwave ovens, work areas etc. is extremely important. Dr. Beckmann Fridge Cleaner with bio-ethanol will quickly ensure hygienic and thorough cleanliness in and around the refrigerator.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Spray onto the surface.
2. For dried soiling it might be necessary to soak briefly.
3. Wipe and dry.
Important information: Always follow the manufacturer's manual. Before use, test for material compatibility on an inconspicuous area. Do not use acryl glass.

details.description:
White laundry becomes yellowed and greyish over time, and therefore loses its brightness. The reason for this is frequent washing at low temperatures or lime deposits in the detergent solution. Dr. Beckmann Glowhite removes greying and gives white laundry its dazzling white appearance back again, even after it is washed again. The content of the practically portioned in-wash doypack can be directly inserted into the washing machine with the white laundry. Not suitable for: Stain removal for suntan lotion and self-tanner. New wool and silk.
It is compatible with all detergents and all washing temperatures above 20 °C (the higher the temperature, the better the result).
Also suitable for white textiles with colour components.
Never apply the powder directly onto the laundry.
Observe the care symbols of the textiles.
details.ingredients: 15-30 % Oxygen-based Bleaching Agents, Less than 5 % Anionic Surfactants, Optical Brighteners
details.usageInstructions:
1.Fill the washing machine with laundry as usual. Dispense the detergent normally.
2.Per wash cycle (up to 5 kg) add 1 Glowhite into the rear area of the drum and start the desired wash program (no quick-wash program).

details.description: White laundry becomes yellowed and greyish over time, and therefore loses its brightness. Dr. Beckmann Glowhite removes greying and gives white laundry its dazzling white appearance back again, even after it is washed again. Not suitable for: Stain removal for suntan lotion and self-tanner. New wool and silk. It is compatible with all detergents and all washing temperatures above 20 °C (the higher the temperature, the better the result). Also suitable for white textiles with colour components. Never apply the powder directly onto the laundry. The size of the sachet is due to technical reasons. Only this can ensure that the powder will dissolve completely within a short time and deliver its full effect at low wash temperatures. Observe the care symbols of the textiles.
details.ingredients: 15-30 % Oxygen-based Bleaching Agents, Less than 5 % Anionic Surfactants, Optical Brighteners
details.usageInstructions:
1.Fill the washing machine with laundry as usual. Dispense the detergent normally.
2.Per wash cycle (up to 5 kg) add 1 Glowhite sachet into the rear area of the drum and start the desired wash program (no quick-wash program).
3.After the wash, simply dispose of the empty sachet in the household waste.

details.description: Dr. Beckmann Granite & Marble Cleaner deeply cleans and gently cares for natural and synthetic stone surfaces. Its powerful yet gentle formula expertly protects the natural surface structure, preserving both value and durability. The effective agent removes even the most stubborn surface grime, leaving a radiant, streak-free shine. Suitable for use on granite, marble, quartz, sandstone, slate, and other synthetic stone surfaces, the cleaner contains no wax, polishing, bleaching agents, acids or salts, and leaves no residues.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Spray onto the surface.
2. Leave to work for a few minutes.
3. Use a damp cloth and rub/clean evenly.
4. Wipe off with a damp cloth.
5. Rub down surface with a clean, dry cloth.

details.description: The powerful gel formula effectively combats and removes limescale, soap residues, watermarks and general dirt from all types of surfaces. It clings to the surface when sprayed so that it can work effectively where needed. Regular usage delays the build-up of new limescale. With fresh scent. Important information: Do not use materials sensitive to acids, such as marble, aluminium etc.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Spray onto the surface.
2. Leave to work for up to 10 minutes, depending on the amount of limescale.
3. Rinse thoroughly with clean water or wipe off with a damp cloth.
4. For heavily soiled surfaces/if necessary, repeat the procedure.
Always follow the manufacturer's manual. Before use, test for material compatibility on an inconspicuous area.

details.description: The adhesive active gel with Activated Carbon removes stubborn burnt-on food residues, encrustations, dirt and grease reliably. The powerful formula also clings to vertical surfaces, cuts through even tough baked-on food and is gentle to the material. Without aggressive or harmful vapours. not suitable for: Aluminium, Plastic, Painted/damaged areas, Galvanized sheet metal, Lacquered or damaged surfaces.
details.usageInstructions:
Shake well before use!
1. Spray onto cold surfaces and close the oven door.
2. Leave to work for at least 20 minutes, for heavily soiled ovens longer. Do not allow to dry.
3. Wash out the oven thoroughly with fresh water and a sponge. Repeat procedure if necessary.
4. Rinse the nozzle after usage.
Important Information: Do not spray into the ventilation system or slits. Do not use on lacquered or damaged surfaces, aluminium surfaces or galvanised plates. Always follow the manufacturer's manual.

details.description: Powerfully cleans kitchen surfaces made from stainless steel, ceramic, cast iron and glass. The innovative formulation with high degreasing action removes grease and dirt deposits effortlessly. The active foam even sticks to vertical surfaces. Stubborn grease residues can be effectively removed. At the same time the cleaner is gentle on delicate surfaces. Important information: Do not spray into the ventilation system or slits. Do not use on wooden, aluminium and on varnished, damaged or hot surfaces.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Spray onto the surface. - Foam function for adhesive active foam: fold down sieve. - Fine spray function for moistening: lift sieve.
2. Leave to work for a few minutes.
3. Use a damp cloth and rub/clean evenly.
4. Wipe off with a damp cloth.
5. Rub down the surface with a clean, dry cloth.
Always follow the manufacturer's manual. Before use, test for material compatibility on an inconspicuous area.

details.description: Easy iron combines two effective processes into one, making ironing easier than ever. You can even remove ironed-in creases, as well as help prevent new wrinkles from forming whilst also repelling dirt. The dual-action formula gives your textiles a perfect, controlled body and a crease.
details.usageInstructions:
Simply spray and iron for a fresh, crisp finish on cotton and linens.
Increases protection from dirt and wear and helps keep clothes cleaner for longer.

details.description: The powerful 3x active formula is a special combination of cleaning agents, stain dissolving activators and bio-alcohol that removes a variety of even stubborn stains. The brush applicator helps to optimally work in the formula and has a stain-lifting effect. The formula contains no perfumes, colourants and bleach that could cause allergic reactions. Gentle to colours and textiles. Removes even stubborn oil & grease-based stains, sauces, chocolate, make-up, lipstick, baby food, fruit & vegetable stains, red wine, coffee, tea etc. Ideal for tough stains from collars & cuffs.
details.ingredients: 5-15 % Non-Ionic Surfactants, Less than 5 % Anionic and Amphoteric Surfactants, Soap, 2-Bromo-2-Nitropropane-1, 3-Diol, Methylisothiazolinone, Benzisothiazolinone
details.usageInstructions:
1. Apply the formula on the stain and work it in with the brush.
2. Leave to work for maximum 10 min.
3. Wash as normal.

details.description: The customised formula of the Dr. Beckmann Stain Devils Pens & Ink considers the special characteristics of stains caused by ballpoint pens, other pens, or watercolours. With the help of a colour-particle remover in the Stain Devils liquid, the colour pigments are separated and removed from the fabric. Ideal for: Stains of Pencils, Colour markers, Felt-tip pens, Finger paints, Flip chart and whiteboard pens, Gel pens, Adhesives (solvent-free), Chalk (street art), Pen Glue/Wood glue (solvent-free), Text markers, Ink (except black), Wax crayons, Watercolours. Not suitable for: Black ink (since it is indelible), Carpets, Leather. For particularly stubborn stains: Allow the fluid to work for longer. Dab the stained area thoroughly with a dry cloth. Wash fabric as normal. For non-washable fabrics: Dab the stained area thoroughly with a damp cloth after following the stain removal method above.
details.usageInstructions:
Moisten stain well with Stain Devils' fluid.
Leave to work for 10–15 mins.
Dab the stained area thoroughly with a dry cloth.
Wash the fabric as normal
Before use:
Test for colour fastness and material compatibility in an inconspicuous area.
Always follow fabric care instructions.
Do not treat stains on sensitive surfaces.
Place a suitable item underneath (e.g. saucer or clean cloth).

details.description:
Removes many fresh stains including coffee, tea, lemonade, fruit juice, yoghurt, baby food, gravies, balsamic vinegar, lipstick and foundation. The Dr. Beckmann Stain Pen even provides reliable, residue-free first aid for dried-in stains. Thanks to its specially designed nib, the Stain Pen remains clean and effective, even after several applications. Just wipe the tap after use or rinse with water.
Always follow fabric care instructions. Test for colour fastness and material compatibility on an inconspicuous area (seam, hem). Suitable for colourfast and washable textiles, especially cotton. If heavily stained, place an absorbent white cloth (e.g. handkerchief) beneath the stain. Not ideal for ink, ballpoint or dark coloured stains. Do not use on silk or dry clean only items. Do not expose treated items to strong sunlight. A second application may sometimes be necessary.
details.ingredients: Surfactant (10%, Sodium 2-ethylhexyl Sulfate, Alcohol Ethoxylate), Enzyme Bleach (Hydrogen Peroxide), Phosphonic Acid 1%, Methylisothiazolinone, Benzisothiazolinone
details.usageInstructions:
Wipe: Remove any stain residue with a napkin or cloth.
Press: Press the tip onto the stain to release the solution.
Rub: Remove stain by gently rubbing the tip of the pen over the stain.
Dab: Dab with a damp cloth to remove any excess solution.

details.description: Removes a broad variety of stains. Fresh stains can be effortlessly removed thanks to an effective combination of surfactants and active oxygen. The Stain Roller allows targeted stain removal. Reliable, residue-free stain removal; kind of colours and fabrics. Ideal for removing grease, coffee, lipstick, make-up, juice, sauce stains, and many more.
details.ingredients: Surfactants (11%, Sodium Alkyl Sulfate, Polyoxyethylene Alkyl Ether), Hydrogen Peroxide (Oxygen-based), Water Softeners, Preservatives, Thickeners, Fragrances, Colorants
details.usageInstructions:
1. Place an absorbent white cloth under the stain and completely dissolve it with the roll-on.
2. Thoroughly dab off the product liquid and dirt with a damp cloth or rinse under running water.

details.description:
Specially formulated to clean and condition all stainless steel surfaces, as well as chrome and aluminium. The innovative, non-abrasive formula provides intensive degreasing power and leaves a glossy, streak-free shine. The active foam reliably sticks, making it ideal for large and vertical surfaces. Perfect for sinks, bathroom fittings, extractor hoods, fridges, appliance or furniture panels, door panels, utensils, etc. Protects metal. Dermatologically tested.
Stainless steel cleaner benefits from ultra-powerful active foam formula - powerful degreaser removes even greasy fingerprints
Fast, effective, streak-free cleaning for both matt and gloss stainless steel and chrome. Suitable for extractor hoods, sinks, taps and more.
Stainless steel cleaner actively protects metal thanks to corrosion inhibitors - for gentle, streak-free kitchen care.
Highly adhesive spray foam - ideal for vertical surfaces
details.usageInstructions:
1. Spray onto the surface. - Foam function for adhesive active foam: fold down sieve Fine spray function for moistening: lift sieve.
2. Leave to work for a few minutes.
3. Use a damp cloth and rub/clean evenly.
4. Wipe off with a damp cloth.
5. Rub down the surface with a clean, dry cloth.

details.description:
Upholstery cleaning made easy Powerful stain & odour removal for sofas, car seats, mattresses, prams and more. The innovative Oxi Power Formula with anti-odour Fresh plex technology penetrates deep into textile fibres to remove wine, juice, sauce and even pet stains while being gentle on fabrics. Thanks to the triangular 2in1 brush, even tough, hard-to-reach stains can be treated without harming colours and fibres. Nothing is left behind but a subtle, fresh scent.
Stains on upholstery like red wine, grease, coffee or even pet messes can now be easily removed thanks to this specially designed upholstery cleaner. Nothing is left behind but a subtle, fresh scent.
The innovative and unique triangular soft brush provides the perfect 2in1 solution to hard-to-reach stains on a diverse range of furniture and upholstery e.g. sofas, mattresses and car seats.
The cutting-edge anti-odour Freshplex technology tackles unpleasant odours while the expert Oxi-Power formula combats even stubborn stains effortlessly.
The powerful, easy-to-use sofa cleaner is gentle on most delicate fabrics and it is both colour and pet safe.
Upholstery Cleaning by Dr. Beckmann: the bottle is made from 100% recycled plastic and the formula is easily biodegradable and free from chlorine bleach.
details.usageInstructions:
Open the bottle and pierce a 2 mm hole in the seal. Screw brush. 
  Remove loose surface dirt. Apply and work lightly into the fabric. Do not soak.
  Let it work for 3 minutes.
Dab off the product and residual stain completely with a damp light-coloured cloth. Rinse the brush.

details.description: The Washing Machine Care Cleaner cleans thoroughly and reliably and removes lime, dirt and deposits, even in hard-to-reach places within the machine. The formula with Activated Carbon releases and captures residues which are then washed out effectively. In addition, special care components protect the rubber and protect metal parts. If applied regularly, the drum, pipes, rubber seals and heater will be kept clean and maintained. This not only protects the machine but also enables an energy-efficient washing and a long service life of the machine.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Clean fluff filter. Shake bottle well before use. Remove the detergent drawer and soak it for 30 min in a solution of 50 ml washing machine cleaner (see marking) diluted in 4 litres of warm water. Clean the dispenser of any residue and insert it back into the machine.
2. Remove fluffs, small stones etc. from the rubber seal. Pour a small amount of the cleaner onto a cloth and wipe the window pane and rubber seal. For maintenance, leave it to work shortly and wipe it off with a damp cloth.
3. Pour the remaining content of the bottle into the main detergent compartment and start the main wash cycle (at least 40 °C) without pre-wash cycle, without detergent and without laundry.
Important Information: -Always follow the manufacturer's manual. Thus, malfunctioning can be prevented. For a long lifespan of the machine. Use once a month for optimum results.

details.description: The Dr. Beckmann Deep Clean Washing Machine Cleaner with Activated Carbon is able to perform a thorough deep cleaning. It can remove unpleasant odours in the washing machine thanks to its special freshness formula. This will avoid a bad-smelling washing machine, and the laundry will maintain its fresh laundry scent. Unpleasant odours can develop within the washing machine through frequent washing at low temperatures. With a regular application of the cleaner, the washing machine will remain thoroughly clean and the laundry fresh. Removes unpleasant odours caused by residues, washing at low temperatures and incorrect dosing of laundry detergents. The Washing Machine Hygiene cleaner thoroughly cleans deep inside your washing machine. Removes deposits caused by detergent build-up. The powerful powder removes bad odours: For fresher and cleaner laundry. Only a deep-cleaned washing machine can promise fresh and truly clean clothes.
details.usageInstructions:
Pour all the powder directly into the washing drum.
Start the main wash cycle (at least 60 °C) without the prewash cycle, without detergent and without laundry. Use once a month for optimum results.

details.description: Dr Beckmann Washing Machine Cleaning Powder has Activated Carbon and is able to perform a thorough deep cleaning. It can remove unpleasant odours in the washing machine thanks to its special hygienic freshness formula. This will avoid a bad-smelling washing machine, and the laundry will maintain its fresh laundry scent.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Pour all the powder (250 g) directly into the washing drum.
2. Start the main wash cycle (at least 60 °C) without the pre-wash cycle, without detergent and without laundry.
3. Once the washing program has finished, the machine is ready for immediate use.
